release_decision.meaning: Suitable for public inspection, bounded evaluation, and low-risk pilots.

assurance_items.title: Canonicalization, hashing, signatures, thresholds, migration, and tamper rejection
assurance_items.limitation: Automated behavior is tested, but the implementation has not received an independent cryptographic review.

assurance_items.title: Clean Windows and Linux verification on every change
assurance_items.limitation: The workflow must complete its first public run before this item can be promoted.

assurance_items.title: Regression coverage minimums
assurance_items.limitation: Coverage shows which code ran during tests; it does not prove that every security property or real-world scenario was tested.

assurance_items.title: Package contents, clean installation, and packaged CLI behavior
assurance_items.limitation: Smoke checks cover declared package behavior, not every downstream operating environment.

assurance_items.title: Dependency audit, dependency review, CodeQL, and secret scanning
assurance_items.limitation: Automated scanners detect known patterns and cannot establish the absence of vulnerabilities.

assurance_items.title: Documentation and implementation drift checks
assurance_items.limitation: These checks reduce internal inconsistency; they do not independently prove usability, security, or protocol correctness.

assurance_items.title: Fresh-context Agent interpretation of bounded evidence scenarios
assurance_items.limitation: The scenarios are bounded and mostly use one Agent family; they do not prove general real-world interpretation quality.

assurance_items.title: Independent security and cryptographic implementation review
assurance_items.limitation: No independent security or cryptographic review report is currently available.

assurance_items.title: Unfamiliar external organization adoption
assurance_items.limitation: OrgAnchor has not yet demonstrated low-friction adoption by an external organization.

assurance_items.title: Measured reduction in real discovery, verification, and comparison cost
assurance_items.limitation: The north-star effect remains a hypothesis until measured across real organizations and third-party decision tasks.

assurance_items.title: Certification that an organization or product is truthful, safe, or best
assurance_items.limitation: OrgAnchor exposes signed records, evidence structure, gaps, and recheck paths; it does not assign final trust.
